name: T-45 Goshawk
summary: Carrier-capable single-engine jet trainer derived from the BAE Hawk, used for Navy and Marine Corps strike pilot training.

wings: Low-mounted swept wing with moderate sweep
Full-span leading-edge slats for slow carrier approaches
engines: Small semicircular intakes on the fuselage sides just ahead of the wing root
fuselage: Stepped tandem two-seat cockpit under a large canopy
Strong carrier landing gear and tailhook
White and orange Navy training colors
tail: All-moving horizontal tail with marked anhedral (droop)
Small fins on the rear fuselage just ahead of the tailplane

tellTales: White and orange carrier trainer with a stepped tandem canopy
Single fin with a low tailplane drooping downward
Small intakes on the fuselage sides above the wing root

confusedWith.howToTell: The T-45 has one engine, a deeper fuselage and a drooping tailplane; the T-38 has two engines and a needle nose on a waisted body.
The T-45 has a single swept fin with drooping tailplane and swept wings; the L-39 has straight wings with tip tanks and intakes set further back.
